headline: Version 7.1 — A Rekviem for the Underworld
summary: Version 7.1 went live. It added Snezhnaya Archon Quest Chapter VII Acts III and IV, including 'White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking' and 'A Rekviem for the Underworld', and introduced new World Quest content.
notes: Game release metadata; this is not an in-world memory for Hu Tao.

headline: Genshin Impact Version 7.2 Special Program Preview
summary: HoYoverse announced the Version 7.2 special-program broadcast, which was scheduled for October 23, 2026.

headline: Starlit Gala Web Event
summary: The Starlit Gala web event opened in October 2026, with activities and a Wonderland year-in-review report for eligible players.
notes: Player-facing web event, not Teyvat world history.

headline: Version 7.2 — Hour of Ruin Trailer
summary: HoYoverse published the Version 7.2 story trailer. Preview footage is not proof that unreleased quest events have already occurred in the live game.
notes: Promotional preview; do not teach as completed history.

headline: Character Skill Showcase — Rules Set at Naught: Mitya
summary: HoYoverse published a character skill showcase for Mitya, introducing the character's combat kit through official promotional material.
notes: Character promotion, not an in-world event report.

headline: Version 7.2 — Paimon's Version Update Notes
summary: HoYoverse announced that Version 7.2 is scheduled to arrive on November 4, 2026, with new story content and quality-of-life changes. On the October 31, 2026 knowledge checkpoint it has not yet released.
notes: Do not teach 7.2 quests as already completed on the October 31 cutoff.

headline: Character Teaser — Mitya: Just a Little Trick
summary: HoYoverse published a character teaser introducing Mitya through promotional story material.
notes: Promotional content, not automatically Teyvat public knowledge.

headline: Character Introduction and Skill Showcase — Fort Fulguration: Valeriy
summary: HoYoverse published an official character introduction and combat-skill showcase for Valeriy.

headline: Version 7.2 New Weapon Overview
summary: HoYoverse published a preview of new weapons associated with Version 7.2.
notes: Patch preview; not an event taking place in Hu Tao's personal life.

headline: Accept Mitya's Invitation for a Stroll?
summary: An official Mitya-themed invitation/stroll web activity was listed on the publisher's news feed.

headline: Beware of Phishing Websites: Keep Your Account Secure
summary: HoYoverse published an account-security reminder about phishing websites.
notes: Player safety notice, not character/world lore.

headline: Genshin Impact November Calendar Wallpapers
summary: HoYoverse published calendar wallpaper materials for November 2026.

headline: Furina Event Wish Announcement

notes: Banner schedule, not a Teyvat story event.

headline: Version 7.1 HoYoverse Top-Up Center Sharing Event — Phase 2
summary: The publisher's Version 7.1 community/top-up sharing campaign continued in October 2026.
